name: Qdrant (local)
summary: Search a local Qdrant collection by meaning.
description: Search a local Qdrant collection by meaning. Available capabilities depend on the provider and the explicitly granted permissions.
about: Search a local Qdrant collection by meaning. Available capabilities depend on the provider and the explicitly granted permissions.
Official mcp-server-qdrant 0.8.1 (Apache-2.0) with an embedded on-disk collection in the server's own folder. No Qdrant account, cloud cluster or API key.

Windows fixture acceptance: the pinned server stored three synthetic notes, then a separate read-only start listed only qdrant-find and returned the expected note first, with the stored collection unchanged.
The first start downloads the pinned embedding model from Hugging Face; no account is needed. Dependencies below the top-level pin are not locked.
Read-only mode is on by default and removes the store tool. Turn it off only on purpose; qdrant-store then writes to the collection.

mcp.name: qdrant

fields.label: Collection folder
fields.tip: Folder for the embedded collection, relative to this server's own folder. Keep the default unless you copy in a collection you made yourself.

fields.label: Collection name
fields.tip: The one collection this server searches. The search tool cannot pick a different collection.

fields.label: Read-only
fields.tip: true removes the store tool so the collection cannot be changed. Choose false only when you want Sara to add notes, each one approved.

fields.label: Embedding model
fields.tip: The qualified local embedding model. It is downloaded once from Hugging Face on first start; no account is needed.

fields.label: Model cache folder
fields.tip: Where the downloaded embedding model is kept, relative to this server's own folder.

fields.label: Model download telemetry
fields.tip: 1 turns off Hugging Face download telemetry for the model download.

reaches: huggingface.co once, to download the embedding model
PyPI and Python downloads through uv at installation
guide: Requires uv/uvx. The recipe asks uv for Python 3.12 because the default Python 3.14 has no prebuilt pydantic-core wheel for this pin and tries a source build.
Qualified: official mcp-server-qdrant 0.8.1 against an embedded synthetic collection on Windows. Qdrant Cloud, a Qdrant server URL and API keys are not part of this recipe.
Keep Read-only at true. qdrant-find then is the only tool; set it to Ask me first. If you choose false, set qdrant-store to Ask me first.
The first start downloads about 90 MB of model files from Hugging Face. Dependencies below the top-level pin are not locked; review them before use with private notes.
After discovery, open Settings → Coding → Tools and approvals. Set every tool in this server's group to Ask me first or Off before sending any request.
Save, leave and reopen the page; read back every tool setting. Repeat after restart, update or newly discovered tools. Stop if settings cannot be confirmed.

changes: First connection recipe. Fixture-qualified on Windows; not published.
